inputs.<tmp:0>/instructions/_schema.awawa:
SCHEMA AGENT
	DESC "a role"
	FIELD WORK string
		REQUIRED
		REPEATABLE
	FIELD REASONING deepest|deep|standard|light
		REQUIRED
	FIELD CAPABILITY read|write|shell|net
		REQUIRED
		REPEATABLE
	FIELD BUDGET uint
	FIELD RETURNS string
		REQUIRED
		REPEATABLE
	FIELD LOADS @RULE
		REPEATABLE

SCHEMA RULE
	DESC "a rule"
	FIELD SPEC string
		REQUIRED
inputs.<tmp:0>/instructions/agents.awawa:
AGENT planner
	WORK "the plan of a wave"
	WORK "the order of its tasks"
	REASONING deep
	CAPABILITY read
	CAPABILITY shell
	BUDGET 40
	RETURNS "the wave plan"
	RETURNS "the blockers"
	LOADS @RULE.plans_are_short

AGENT stray
	WORK "anything"
	REASONING light
	CAPABILITY read
	BUDGET 10
	RETURNS "something"

RULE plans_are_short
	SPEC "a plan fits one screen"

outcome.stderr: awawa show: @AGENT.verifier is not defined in the workspace
